name: Cheyenne
housing: Cheyenne's rentals are mostly single-family houses and apartment complexes, with many military families renting near F.E. Warren Air Force Base.
climate: Test the furnace, check windows and doors for drafts and photograph the roof and siding for hail and wind damage; winters are cold and very windy.
fact: F.E. Warren Air Force Base is in Cheyenne, so many renters are military families.
